title: Good Soup!
description: Adds delicious soup to the game.
body:
Tired of eating boring old minecraft food?
Now you can eat food with a difference!
Each added soup gives you amazing effects, and also has a chance of giving you one of two rare effects or encounters!

for example.... Put one of every raw meat in a bowl and get the strength effect! There is a 20% chance of making all nearby mobs glow in the dark! And a 10% chance to fight an evil rabbit!...well it might not be evil...you did eat his brother...

anyway... Theres 12 new soups to try out and discover what they do.
Bon Appetit!
